Perfect! All 30 tests pass. I've added two new functions to `src/invoices.js`:

1. **`lineTotal(line)`** — Returns qty × unitPrice in cents (always an integer)
2. **`invoiceTotals(invoice)`** — Returns `{ subtotal, total }` where both equal the sum of line totals (total will diverge when discounts and VAT are added later)

Added 5 tests covering:
- Basic lineTotal calculations with various quantities and prices
- Single-line and multi-line invoice totals
- Integer validation (all amounts are whole cents)
